The Future of Medi-Facial
The DermaFrac Treatment
DermaFrac is ISAAC Luxe's advanced two-step medi-facial — exfoliating away dulling dead skin, then infusing high-grade serums deep into the dermal layers for smoother, healthier, more radiant skin. No pain, no downtime, no anaesthesia.

DermaPeel — Exfoliate + Rejuvenate

A crystal-free Bio-Barrier tip gently exfoliates the outermost layer of dead skin, revitalising your skin from the very first step.

DermaFrac — Microneedling + Infusion

Patented dermal micro-channeling technology effectively delivers high-grade proprietary serums deep into the dermal layers, achieving unprecedented results.

Hydrate & Lighten Serums

Hydrate Serum

A “super hydrator” for anyone and everyone. Dehydration is an issue that affects every age and every skin type.

Ideal For
Dry or Dehydrated Skin
What to Expect

Immediate firmness will be noted; optimal benefits are generally seen after 3 sessions.

Lighten Serum

A standard for the treatment of pigmentation and skin discolouration issues. Kojic Acid is considered one of the better solutions for such skin anomalies.

Ideal For
PigmentationSkin DiscolourationGlow
What to Expect

Visible reduction in underlying pigment both immediately and ongoing, with improved tone and texture.

Personalised Infusion Therapy
Vitamin C & Clarify Serums

Vitamin C Serum

For any skin type and any age group, Vitamin C is a well-known antioxidant. Anyone with sun damage or aging skin needs a good antioxidant to help reduce the effects of free radicals in the skin.

Ideal For
Environmental DamageFree RadicalsAntioxidant
What to Expect

Visible improvement of skin tone & elasticity.

Clarify Serum

A formula containing salicylic acid and lactic acid, designed to exfoliate, cleanse and clarify oily and congested skin.

Ideal For
Oily SkinAcne
What to Expect

Visible reduction in acne, redness and improved skin pores.

The Visionary Behind ISAAC Luxe
Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta
Founder and Medical Director of ISAAC Luxe / Aesthetic Physician, and award-winning cosmetologist — Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta is one of India's most sought-after skin experts.

With over 15 years of experience in aesthetics, Dr. Geetika has built a reputation for personalised care and delivering results with minimal risk. Her clientele includes celebrities, influencers, and discerning individuals who trust her expertise.

She is a pioneer in introducing globally advanced treatments to India — from AI-integrated diagnostics and cutting-edge IV therapy to advanced body sculpting technology — setting new benchmarks in luxury dermatology.

Qualifications

MBBS from Govt. Medical College, Patiala. Post-graduation in Aesthetic Medicine from Cardiff University, UK. Diploma in Aesthetic Medicine from the American Academy of Aesthetic Medicine.

Global Expertise

Attended numerous international workshops and conferences globally. Known for blending ancient and modern scientific techniques to deliver trusted, clinically tested treatments.

Celebrity Trusted

Preferred aesthetic destination for Bollywood celebrities, fashion icons, social media influencers, and high-profile personalities across India's entertainment and fashion industry.

Three-Tier Philosophy

Unique AI-driven approach to long-term beauty built on three pillars: Treatment, Prevention, and Maintenance — ensuring lasting results and healthier skin over time.
